analyst_view.overall: Early view: Groningen host bottom side Willem II on a Friday night six days after the northern derby. Etienne Vaessen and Hans Hateboer, listed as missing, will have served their one-match bans against Heerenveen and should be available again. Willem II have 3 points and lost 7-0 at PSV, but drew 1-1 with PEC under new coach Jurgen Streppel.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.8 goals. Groningen's games have been high-scoring (2-3, 3-4) and Willem II leak goals, but with Vaessen back in goal I see no reason to go above the estimate.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.5 corners. I lean a little higher: Groningen press high and Willem II will spend long spells defending deep, as they did at PSV.

cards.text: The numbers say 2.7 cards. Vaessen's temper is a known risk, but against a team this far below them Groningen should rarely be under pressure; I keep the estimate.

shots.text: The numbers say 30.3 shots, mostly Groningen's. That fits a home side with Ondrejka, Willumsson and Van Bergen all scoring against a team in last place.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.6 shots on target. Groningen's attack has been productive even in defeat, which supports the figure.
